instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Indoors, against a light wood-paneled wall, the Black woman with short blonde hair in the white sleeveless top and red pants (R2) leans against a red counter on the left, holding a paper cup and smiling at her companion. On the right, the Asian woman in the black sleeveless top and brown skirt (R1) stands holding her paper cup with both hands, her eyes closed in a gentle smile. The two are positioned close together in friendly conversation. Soft, warm indoor lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the vibrant red counter and wooden background.
